scope: Proposition 4.4 of the manuscript “Bloch’s conjecture for surfaces with p_g=0” (preprints/Blochs-Conjecture-for-Surfaces-with-pg-equals-q-equals-0-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 040 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 afb7bf56f8d97111), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 17. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume pg = q = 0. A nonempty fixed part with lines T, H and lengths satisfying (4.2) is the smooth product W = |T| × |H| × X[n1] × X[n2] . Let xi = c1(O|Di|(1)), with D1 = T, D2 = H. The fixed virtual class is [W]vir = 2 ∏ i=1 ( x h1(Di) i e(Fi) ) ∩ [W], Fi = ( (K − Di)[ni])∨ ⊗ O(1i). (4.8) A part with either mT < 0 or mH < 0 contributes zero. For the other parts, after including e(F1) e(F2), pushforward over the linear systems is coefficient extraction at [xmT 1 xmH 2 ].
